A '''snow skiff''' was a type of [[skiff]] used by [[Unidentified raiders|raiders]] on the frozen [[Planet|world]] of [[Barton IV]]. It was used to steal [[Cargo container|crates]] with [[TK stormtrooper armor|armor]] and equipment for [[TK stormtrooper|TK troopers]].<ref name="The Outpost" />
